# Patient Consultation Request Generates Prescription Test Suite

Feature: Patient Consultation Request Generates Prescription
  As a patient, I want to ensure that each consultation request generates exactly one prescription
  And as a chemist/lab, I want to ensure that each prescription is correctly mapped to a single consultation request

  Background:
  Given a Patient Consultation Request has been created
  And a Chemist is assigned to process prescriptions
  And a Lab is assigned to process prescriptions

  Scenario: Generate prescription for a single consultation request
    | input                           | expected                                                                   | requirement id |
    | 'valid consultation request'          | 'valid prescription generated'                                                 | U18_5          |

  Scenario: Generate prescription for multiple consultation requests
    | input                           | expected                                                                   | requirement id |
    | 'multiple valid consultation requests' | 'each generates one prescription'                                              | U18_5          |

  Scenario: Chemist receives one or more prescriptions
    | input                           | expected                                                                   | requirement id |
    | 'one valid consultation request'     | 'chemist receives one prescription'                                            | U18_5          |
    | 'multiple valid consultation requests' | 'chemist receives one or more prescriptions'                                 | U18_5          |

  Scenario: Each prescription is mapped to one and only one Chemist
    | input                           | expected                                                                   | requirement id |
    | 'one valid consultation request'     | 'prescription mapped to one chemist'                                          | U18_5          |
    | 'multiple valid consultation requests' | 'each prescription mapped to one chemist'                                     | U18_5          |

  Scenario: Each prescription is mapped to one and only one Lab
    | input                           | expected                                                                   | requirement id |
    | 'one valid consultation request'     | 'prescription mapped to one lab'                                           | U18_5          |
    | 'multiple valid consultation requests' | 'each prescription mapped to one lab'                                       | U18_5          |

  Scenario: Chemist receives one or more prescriptions from multiple consultation requests
    | input                           | expected                                                                   | requirement id |
    | 'multiple valid consultation requests' | 'chemist receives one or more prescriptions'                                 | U18_5          |

  Scenario: Lab receives one or more prescriptions from multiple consultation requests
    | input                           | expected                                                                   | requirement id |
    | 'multiple valid consultation requests' | 'lab receives one or more prescriptions'                                | U18_5          |

  Scenario: Chemist receives one or more prescriptions and is assigned to process them
    | input                           | expected                                                                   | requirement id |
    | 'multiple valid consultation requests' | 'chemist receives one or more prescriptions and is assigned to process' | U18_5          |

  Scenario: Lab receives one or more prescriptions and is assigned to process them
    | input                           | expected                                                                   | requirement id |
    | 'multiple valid consultation requests' | 'lab receives one or more prescriptions and is assigned to process' | U18_5          |

  Scenario: Each prescription is mapped to one and only one Chemist and Lab
    | input                           | expected                                                                   | requirement id |
    | 'one valid consultation request'     | 'each prescription is mapped to one chemist and one lab'                   | U18_5          |
    | 'multiple valid consultation requests' | 'each prescription is mapped to one chemist and one lab'                 | U18_5          |

  Scenario: Each Chemist and Lab receives one or more prescriptions
    | input                           | expected                                                                   | requirement id |
    | 'multiple valid consultation requests' | 'each chemist and lab receives one or more prescriptions'                 | U18_5          |

  Scenario: Each Chemist and Lab is assigned to process prescriptions
    | input                           | expected                                                                   | requirement id |
    | 'multiple valid consultation requests' | 'each chemist and lab is assigned to process prescriptions' | U18_5          |

  Scenario: Each Chemist and Lab is assigned to process prescriptions and receives them
    | input                           | expected                                                                   | requirement id |
    | 'multiple valid consultation requests' | 'each chemist and lab is assigned to process and receive prescriptions' | U18_5          |
